notes: Booklet contains two models: Naida's gondola with Naida minifigure (steps 1-13), and the goblin rock scene with the goblin (steps 1-15). Both are included in one graph; b1-b35 gondola/Naida, b36-b67 goblin scene.
Type ids use the 7-digit design numbers from the inventory pages (no catalogue match existed for them).

Exact stud positions are hard to read in the low-resolution images; where a piece sits on one of several neighbouring pieces (tile and bracket b7/b8, tooth plates b14/b15 and b49/b50, map b27, compass b26, basket b28, goblin rock layers) I chose the most plausible supporting piece.
Second hull b4 is flipped over the first and snaps on the 1x8 plates (step 3).

Naida and the goblin are in the 'set aside' figure assembly on page 2: Naida (hair, head, torso, legs, bowl) sits on the gondola in the final picture; the goblin holds the eye tile and stands behind the rock (modelled as contact on the lime plate b48).
The branch b61 attaches to the Technic piece b56 via an assumed pin; the chest b58 is joined to b56 through the red peg b57 and flips open (page 29).
Gems b29/b30 are placed in the basket (step 13). The second lime/purple flower b63/b65 sits loose on the baseplate studs.
